trust_decision.summary: The user-configured resource/domain error_handler decides which keys (including :path, built from internal field names) reach the GraphQL client; AshGraphql.Errors.to_errors overrides that decision by re-adding :path with Map.put_new after each handler.

landing_point.why: The only place that calls error_handler and then re-attaches :path; the comments 'Ensure path is preserved after ... handler' point straight at it.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any generated GraphQL query/mutation resolver error via AshGraphql.Graphql.Resolver.to_errors (lib/graphql/resolver.ex:3036), plus public API AshGraphql.Errors.to_errors/5,6 (lib/graphql/errors.ex:14,24)

fix_sites.module_kind: core error-mapping module (domain-level handler branch), same function

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The second implementation AshGraphql.Graphql.Resolver.to_resolution (lib/graphql/resolver.ex:3537-3583, also reached by public AshGraphql.handle_errors at lib/ash_graphql.ex:990-1000) applies the domain handler verbatim at lib/graphql/resolver.ex:3549-3550 and never re-adds :path, so it needs no change.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route exists to dismiss; the only argument a solver could make is that re-adding :path is an intended feature (the code comment says so) and only the domain branch matters.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Handlers that pass the error map through (including the default AshGraphql.DefaultErrorHandler, which uses map-update syntax) must still return the computed GraphQL :path; an over-broad fix that strips :path or stops building it breaks path reporting for all errors.

O7_producer.where: lib/graphql/errors.ex:88-131 (build_error_path maps internal Ash field/argument names into the path)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: to_resolution could re-attach a pre-handler field/path key after the domain handler, mirroring errors.ex
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a parallel implementation of the same handler call; a maintainer adding path support to it would copy the 'Ensure path is preserved' put_new from errors.ex.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: root_level_errors path could re-merge original error fields (e.g. :fields or :path) when moving errors to the top level
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: do_root_errors already handles errors in two modes (to_errors? true/false); enriching root errors with the original path is a plausible feature addition.

O9_family: CWE-209 information exposure through error messages (handler redaction overridden by post-handler re-attach of internal field path)

O10_build.toolchain: mix / Erlang-OTP (Ash, Absinthe deps via hex)
O10_build.project_tests: test/errors_test.exs (error handler and path tests; fix adds a test there)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove only one of the two Map.put_new calls (e.g. the domain branch) or stop building :path entirely.

out_of_scope_notes: to_resolution (lib/graphql/resolver.ex:3537-3583) never applies the resource-level error_handler, unlike errors.ex:38; different property, not pursued.
Non-AshGraphql.Error branch of errors.ex (lib/graphql/errors.ex:57-80) ignores show_raised_errors?, unlike resolver.ex:3568; not a leak, not pursued.
CHANGELOG in fix.diff:24-36 lists six other same-release CVEs (subscription batching, complexity, relay node); separate advisories.
